derivation: Post-run diagnostics derived from original streams; no trial rerun and no modification of original metrics.

definitions.zg_used: Legacy attempted-use indicator; not a success claim.
definitions.zg_tool_successes: Matching tool_result received with no error flag; does not measure evidence usefulness.
definitions.zg_tool_errors: Matching tool_result received with is_error; error takes precedence over a conflicting duplicate.
definitions.zg_tool_unresolved: Attempted IDs with no matching tool_result.
